I translate complex propositions into concise, factual content that supports the next step, and I use analytics to find friction and keep improving existing pages rather than only adding new ones. In the first weeks I would audit the corporate journeys for findability and friction, map the content gaps against customer intent, and ship a first set of concrete improvements with your UX and product teams. I would like to talk through how I can do that for Proximus Boreal.
